visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a face mask and glasses stands on a stool, reaching up to a wall-mounted air conditioner. He uses a small green brush to scrub the internal black fins of the unit. The room is a bright, modern living space with large windows revealing lush green outdoor foliage. (2) The scene shifts to the man spraying a clear liquid from a bottle onto the AC unit, followed by close-up shots of his hands vigorously brushing the components. Small white captions appear on the screen describing the action. (3) The man is then seen in a warehouse-like environment surrounded by tall stacks of brown cardboard boxes. He is wearing a grey Adidas t-shirt and looks at his smartwatch while talking to a woman standing slightly behind him. (4) The setting changes to a crowded pet exhibition where the man, a woman, and a young child pose for a photo. There are posters of cats in the background and white display racks. (5) Back in a bright white kitchen, the man presents a bowl of dark 'stewed pig's blood' and a package of konjac noodles to the camera. He wears a yellow t-shirt with a monkey graphic. (6) A montage shows him boiling noodles in a silver pot, slicing garlic and mushrooms on a wooden cutting board, and stir-frying the ingredients in a black pan over a gas stove. (7) The man sits at a wooden dining table, eating the noodles with chopsticks and drinking from a glass filled with ice and a dark liquid. A woman sits across from him. (8) A final simple animation features two small figures on a solid yellow background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, acoustic guitar-driven pop track. A male voice speaks energetically, punctuated by a short 'whoosh' transition effect. (2) Rhythmic 'psst' sounds of a spray bottle occur twice, followed by the high-frequency grating sound of a plastic brush scrubbing a hard surface. The man's voice maintains a lighthearted, conversational tone. (3) A digital 'ding' sound effects occurs as new text overlays appear. The ambient sound floor includes muffled indoor chatter. (4) Transitioning to the kitchen, the sharp metallic click of a stove igniting is followed by a steady bubbling water sound. Rapid rhythmic thuds of a knife hitting a wooden cutting board are layered over the continuous BGM. (5) A loud, broadband sizzling sound indicates stir-frying. The man's voice narrates with a high pitch variability, showing excitement about the ingredients. (6) Soft wet slurping sounds and the sharp clink of ice cubes against a glass characterize the eating phase. The BGM maintains its steady tempo until the end where a final cartoonish 'boing' sound effect plays over the outro animation.
